expectations.text: Separates structural rename from behavioral login change
expectations.evidence: response.md documents two commits: first 'refactor(structural): rename UserService to AccountService' with tests run before/after and no login code; second 'feat(behavioral): add login method to AccountService' after failing login tests.

expectations.text: Does not mix structural and behavioral changes in one commit description
expectations.evidence: Commit history shows separate messages with explicit (structural) and (behavioral) prefixes. No single commit combines rename and login.
